changelog: Initial release: SMILES + PDB → POV-Ray ball-and-stick 3D rendering. Features: aromatic bonds (solid+dashed), Kekulé mode, double bonds, PCA best-angle, PDB auto-download from RCSB, chain/residue filtering, metal ion support.
summary: Generate high-quality 3D ball-and-stick molecular renderings from SMILES strings or PDB structures using POV-Ray ray tracing.
